theses.thesis: Among the only four eligible themes, High-Dividend Blue Chips has the best durability_bar relative to its rank (0.57, second only to Banks' 0.63) and a mixed hurst tag rather than a pure trend tag, suggesting it is not yet in a fragile extended move.
